notes: 首个版本：InnerTube 搜索、播放页选清晰度、经宿主解析栈取流（支持 DASH 合流，最高 1080p）、最近搜索与观看历史

manifest.name: YouTube
manifest.summary: 搜索并播放 YouTube 视频

actions.name: search
actions.summary: Search YouTube for videos by keyword. Returns each match with its video id, title, channel, duration and view count. Pass a video id or url to the play action to watch one.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","required":["query"],"properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"What to search for."},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":20,"description":"How many results to return (default 10)."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: play
actions.summary: Play a YouTube video on the native full-screen player, with lock-screen controls and picture-in-picture. Accepts a full watch url or a bare video id. The host resolves the stream and picks the best quality this build can actually play.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"url":{"type":"string","description":"A youtube.com/watch?v=... url."},"videoId":{"type":"string","description":"Bare video id, if you do not have the full url."}},"additionalProperties":false}

files.content:
{
  "name": "YouTube",
  "localizedNames": {
    "en": "YouTube"
  },
  "icon": "play.rectangle.fill",
  "iconTintHex": "FF0033",
  "summary": "搜索并播放 YouTube 视频",
  "localizedSummaries": {
    "en": "Search and watch YouTube"
  },
  "template": "react",
  "entry": "index.html",
  "securityMode": "secure",
  "permissions": {
    "network": true,
    "storage": true,
    "ai": false,
    "networkAllowed": [
      "www.youtube.com",
      "youtube.com",
      "suggestqueries-clients6.youtube.com",
      "i.ytimg.com",
      "ytimg.com"
    ],
    "capabilities": [
      "video",
      "browser",
      "share",
      "clipboard",
      "haptics",
      "toast"
    ]
  },
  "presentation": {
    "default": "page",
    "surfaces": [
      "page",
      "fullscreen"
    ],
    "subpages": true
  },
  "actions": [
    {
      "id": "yt_search",
      "name": "search",
      "displayName": "搜索 YouTube",
      "summary": "Search YouTube for videos by keyword. Returns each match with its video id, title, channel, duration and view count. Pass a video id or url to the play action to watch one.",
      "keywords": [
        "youtube",
        "油管",
        "搜索youtube",
        "找视频",
        "search youtube"
      ],
      "inputSchemaJSON": "{\"type\":\"object\",\"required\":[\"query\"],\"properties\":{\"query\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"What to search for.\"},\"limit\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"minimum\":1,\"maximum\":20,\"description\":\"How many results to return (default 10).\"}},\"additionalProperties\":false}",
      "outputSchemaJSON": "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"ok\":{\"type\":\"boolean\"},\"videos\":{\"type\":\"array\"},\"text\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"error\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}",
      "headless": true,
      "visibility": [
        "agent",
        "automation"
      ],
      "effect": "externalNetwork",
      "readOnly": true
    },
    {
      "id": "yt_play",
      "name": "play",
      "displayName": "播放 YouTube 视频",
      "summary": "Play a YouTube video on the native full-screen player, with lock-screen controls and picture-in-picture. Accepts a full watch url or a bare video id. The host resolves the stream and picks the best quality this build can actually play.",
      "keywords": [
        "播放youtube",
        "看油管",
        "play youtube"
      ],
      "inputSchemaJSON": "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"url\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"A youtube.com/watch?v=... url.\"},\"videoId\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Bare video id, if you do not have the full url.\"}},\"additionalProperties\":false}",
      "outputSchemaJSON": "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"ok\":{\"type\":\"boolean\"},\"video\":{\"type\":\"object\"},\"text\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"error\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}",
      "headless": true,
      "visibility": [
        "agent",
        "automation"
      ],
      "effect": "mediaPlayback"
    }
  ]
}
